video.title: AI欧腐《驯服继承人/Taming the Heir：Pushing Buttons》
video.desc:
又是你们Ashford家族
After a car crash kills his father, heir Elliot loses use of his hands and legs to trauma, shutting himself in darkness. Brash street-fighter Miles is hired as his caretaker and drags him back to life through relentless, unorthodox provocations. When cousin Dominic—who engineered the crash—kidnaps Miles, Elliot rises, rescues him, exposes the conspiracy, and walks again. The two stay together as lifelong partners.
一场车祸夺走了父亲的性命，继承人Elliot也因心理创伤导致手脚失去行动能力，从此把自己封闭在黑暗之中。莽撞直率的街头拳手Miles受雇成为他的护工，用一次次不按常理出牌的挑衅，硬是把他拽回了生活。当一手策划车祸的堂兄Dominic绑架了Miles，Elliot重新站了起来，救出Miles，揭穿了整个阴谋，也终于再度行走。此后两人相伴一生，成为彼此的终身伴侣。
